QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Unsettling Future 4
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bClaudine the Turncoat#k in #bTwilight Perion#k.
QuestInfo.1: According to Claudine, when the Black Mage conquered Maple World, the Resistance left the Alliance and joined him. At least in the fabricated future of Perion, that is.
QuestInfo.2: You took a rough glance around Perion in the fabricated future. All that remains is...

0.0: Our great leader has made this world a better place. Maple World was an uncivilized wreck of chaos before the #rBlack Mage#k came and shaped it into his vision. And I've found my rightful calling, transforming this sweltering rock-pit into a wonder of modern engineering.

yes.0: Look at these laborers, aging away with so little dignity! I will stay young and beautiful forever! Haha!

no.0: Why are you talking to me now?

0.1: Who wouldn't turn their back on that silly #bAlliance#k for glory like this?

npc.0: Look at these laborers, aging away with so little dignity! I will stay young and beautiful forever! Haha!
